name: go_to
description: Walk to a place, a player, a mob, the nearest block of a type, or the spot a player is looking at. A player out of sight: first to where she last saw them. "Come here" / "next to me": player:<name> with range 1. "Go there" / "stand here" while they point their view at a spot: looking:<name> with range 0. "Climb the mountain" / "get to the top": peak (the highest ground near, see your state). "Get out" / "go up" underground: surface (the way out to the sky; with dig=yes it digs up when there is none).
done_when: she is within range of the target (for a player: also at their level, within 1 block up or down; range 0: standing on that exact block)
stops_when: no path, target not found or gone, attacked, time limit

target.description: "x y z", "x z", "player:<name>", "mob:<type>", "block:<type>", "looking:<player>", "peak" or "surface" (looking: where they look)

range.description: how close counts as arrived, in blocks (0: on that exact block; for a player at least 1)

dig.description: yes: she may break blocks to get there: dig down into a hole, a tunnel to a player, steps up a slope too steep to walk

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 60, at most 300)

name: mine
description: Break blocks of one type nearby and collect what drops. "log" means any kind of log.
done_when: she has collected count of what the block drops
stops_when: none left within radius, no suitable tool, unreachable, attacked badly, time limit

block.description: block name, e.g. oak_log, stone, coal_ore, or "log"

radius.description: how far to look, in blocks

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 120, at most 600)

name: fight
description: Fight with her best weapon: the nearest hostile (creepers first, then skeletons, then zombies), a hostile type, or an animal or other mob by name when asked or needed (e.g. sheep for wool, cow for leather): count of them. Never players.
done_when: count of the target are dead (hostiles: all of that type nearby), or none are left nearby
stops_when: health low (retreats, then eats), outnumbered (flees), none found, time limit

target.description: "nearest_hostile" or a mob type, e.g. zombie, sheep

count.description: how many to kill (default: all hostiles of the type nearby; 1 for any other mob)

radius.description: how far from her to look for them, in blocks

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 90, at most 300)

name: eat
description: Eat the best food she has, or a named food.

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 10, at most 30)

name: sleep
description: Sleep in the nearest bed until morning (also sets where she respawns).
done_when: she wakes up in the morning
stops_when: no bed nearby, not night, monsters nearby, bed taken

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 480, at most 600)

name: craft
description: Craft an item from what she carries, using a crafting table nearby if the recipe needs one.
stops_when: no recipe, missing ingredients (says which), needs a crafting table and none is placed nearby

item.description: item name, e.g. oak_planks, stick, wooden_pickaxe

count.description: how many to end up with

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 30, at most 120)

name: follow_player
description: Stay close to a player for a while. Out of sight: first walks to where she last saw them.
done_when: the time asked for is up
stops_when: the player leaves or gets out of sight, attacked, stopped

distance.description: how close to stay, in blocks

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 605, at most 605)

name: place
description: Put down a block she carries (e.g. a crafting table, a torch, a furnace): next to her, or at a spot. A full block (dirt, cobblestone) can also go into water or lava, resting against a solid block beside it.
stops_when: she has none, the spot is taken or has nothing to rest on, can't reach it

where.description: optional "x y z"; default: a free spot next to her

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 30, at most 60)

name: collect_items
description: Pick up items lying on the ground nearby (all, or one kind).
done_when: nothing (of that kind) is left within the radius
stops_when: nothing to pick up, items out of reach, inventory full

radius.description: how far to look, in blocks

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 60, at most 180)

name: give
description: Walk up to a player and toss them some of an item.
done_when: the items are tossed to them
stops_when: she has none, the player isn't around, can't reach them

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 60, at most 120)

name: look_at
description: Turn to look at a player, a mob, a block or a place for a few seconds.
stops_when: the target isn't around or leaves

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 35, at most 35)

name: store
description: Put items into the nearest chest or barrel: one kind, or "all" (keeps tools, weapons, armour, food, torches).
done_when: the items are in the chest
stops_when: no chest within 16 blocks, she has none of it, the chest is full

count.description: optional: how many (default: all she has)

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 60, at most 120)

name: take
description: Take items out of the nearest chest or barrel.
done_when: she has taken count (or all there was)
stops_when: no chest within 16 blocks, the chest has none of it, her inventory is full

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 60, at most 120)

name: smelt
description: Smelt or cook items in the nearest furnace (raw iron -> iron ingot, raw beef -> steak...), adding fuel she carries.
done_when: she has taken out count smelted items
stops_when: no furnace within 16 blocks, she has none of it, no fuel, it can't be smelted

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 120, at most 700)

name: wear
description: Put armor on: a named piece, or the best she carries for every slot that has nothing better on already.
stops_when: no armor to put on, or nothing better than what she wears

item.description: optional armor item, e.g. iron_chestplate; leave out for her best armor

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 10, at most 30)

name: hold
description: Hold an item in her hand (or off-hand): by name, by kind ("sword" = her best sword), or the item in a hotbar slot 1-9. Use it when the user asks her to use or switch to something. It stays in her hand until a skill needs another (mine, eat, place and fight switch by themselves).
stops_when: she has no such item, or that slot is empty

item.description: an item id or kind, e.g. wooden_sword, sword, torch; "nothing" for an empty hand

slot.description: a hotbar slot instead of an item: hold what is in it

hand.description: main hand (default) or off-hand (shield, torch, totem)

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 5, at most 15)

name: put_in_hotbar
description: Arrange her hotbar: put an item into hotbar slot 1-9 (what was there swaps to where the item was). For when the user wants things in particular slots ("sword in slot 1").
done_when: the item is in that slot

item.description: an item id or kind, e.g. stone_pickaxe, sword

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 10, at most 30)

name: surface
description: Swim up for air: straight up through open water, or to the nearest air pocket when something is overhead. Her breathing reflex does this by itself whenever her air runs low under water.
done_when: her head is out of the water and she has her breath back
stops_when: no air within reach, time limit

time_limit.description: seconds before it gives up (default 20, at most 60)
